Teo hauls glass to Anchorage as the harp registers the deepest Narrowing on record; Hesper announces the Withdrawal.
Juno, home from the Severance, watches the Wheel draw her sister Pell as a Keeper of the Thirtieth.
Isra strips a glass-crusted Return in the Ossuary; the Lamplighter proclaims a Great Keeping.
Teo flies Ambrose to the mouth to drop his buoy; Hesper proposes the Keeping and offers debt release to any pilot who flies it.
Juno petitions to take Pell's place; Adaeze takes the petition, Mor refuses it, and Rhee Calder sends a question.
Isra sells harp wire to Brother Lucan at the Anchor; the Lantern levies every gram of glass in the Reach.
Ambrose hears a second rhythm under the Narrowing; Corrigan volunteers for the trial Keeping; Nico's cutters vote.
Adaeze finds the oldest harp records gone and the Founder's Fork out of tune with the Hunger Tone; Juno captures a woman with a list.
Lucan tunes the harp to the First Warden's Fork and sees what fills the throat.
Corrigan flies the trial Keeping; Hesper calls it a success; the cutters of Shaft Nine down tools.
The Shoals strike the Anchorhold; Juno pulls Adaeze from the archive; two secrets are traded.
The Lantern burns the Gutter; Hanne dies singing; the Lamplighter takes the Anchor.
Ambrose proves what the Needle does on its own, and tells the shaft.
Adaeze retunes the harp to the Fork; Juno meets Rhee on Corrie Rock; Mor listens at the door.
Lucan reads the throat's layers and counts the Keepings in them; a plan to ring the Needle; Pike volunteers.
Ambrose gives Teo the spool; the strike is broken; Hesper makes Teo an offer.
Juno breaks Adaeze out and they steal the Testament; Juno takes the Vigil over to the Shoals.
Saar gives Lucan to the Lamplighter; the Needle returns the Lamplighter's son; Isra takes back the Fork.
The battle at the throat, and the broadcast.
The Sixtieth Narrowing, the ringing, and what comes back.
